data: Amazon's net income was a loss of $2.72 billion in fiscal 2022 and a profit of $59.25 billion in fiscal 2024. The swing of about $61.97 billion works out to roughly a 2,277% change if you divide by the absolute value of the 2022 loss. That percentage is mathematically correct but not very meaningful, because the base year was negative, so the dollar swing is the more useful measure. For reference, fiscal 2023 net income was $30.43 billion.
